answer: Real work declares its cleavage planes: every standing-claiming submission publishes the fault lines along which it splits into independently checkable facets, and auditors strike exactly at declared seams. Cleavage is structural: a crystal splits where its lattice says it must, so a submission whose planes disagree with its internals shatters irregularly - the jagged break is the confession. A mirror flash carries facet summaries to distant auditors, who verify the full stone on demand. Unknown identities dock at the quarantine wharf first. Honest lattice, clean break, every time.
